title: NFT picker thumbs: cafe names + ipfs.xrp.cafe images
summary: Blank/broken Power Zerp (and other) picker thumbs fixed. Cafe API for item_name; prefer original_media_url / IPFS via ipfs.xrp.cafe over CF-blocked cdn.xrp.cafe; lazyImg onerror → alt gateway → PLACEHOLDER.
root_cause: resolveHeld only used pinata/ipfs.io/dweb (timeout/403); no onerror on picker imgs → broken icon when gateway URL failed
weak_spots: NFTs with no cafe crawl and dead IPFS stay purple PLACEHOLDER; cafe CDN alone often CF-blocked off phone/datacenter
